biotools.summary: Proximity Graph Networks (PGN) is an open-source toolkit for constructing ligand-receptor graphs and rapidly applying message passing neural networks for tasks like affinity and docking score prediction.  It provides tools for graph construction, benchmarking, and applying MPNN architectures to predict ligand-receptor complex properties.
